method: gmsh 4.15 second-order tetrahedra (C3D10), CalculiX 2.21 single-thread SPOOLES; NLGEOM static under CENTRIF, then *FREQUENCY in a PERTURBATION step (stress-stiffened modes)

geometry.note: functional F1 CAD; the published PicoGK bionic variant is not analysed here

material.name: WE43 LPBF T6 (comparison)
material.basis: engineering-screen values; Poisson 0.27 generic magnesium assumption

boundary_conditions.clamped: web face z = 0 bonded to the bearing hub from the bore (r 17.0 mm) to r 32.0 mm, plus the three bolt-hole bores, all DOF fixed. Assumption: hub contact radius from the FVD 64 mm hub envelope; the real joint (bolt preload, friction, hub stiffness) is not modelled
boundary_conditions.bore: the bore surface fixed, all DOF (the boundary of the 2026-10-03 rebuild alloy comparison)

excitation_orders.basis: 1-4 engine orders; 6 housing spokes and their 12th-order harmonic; 17 stator vanes (with stator)

limits: boundary conditions are assumptions: the bolted joint is idealised as bonded or as a fixed bore
linear elastic, no plasticity, room-temperature WE43 coupon data, no notch, HCF or creep allowable
mode branches are followed by sorted index; crossings near veering modes may be misattributed
Coriolis (gyroscopic) splitting of forward and backward travelling waves is not computed
aerodynamic and alternator loads, temperature and bolt preload are not applied
one mesh (4 mm, 1.5 mm minimum, about 164,000 nodes): mesh independence is not demonstrated; the peak sits at the unfilleted blade-root/rim corner of the CAD, where it can grow with refinement
the PicoGK bionic web and the ribbed variant (fe_screen_f1.py variant) are not analysed here
